title: V1.0.6K local O:NR card release adds 20 confirmed cards
preconditions: The private local O:NR v1 overlay exists under data/local.
The previous V1.0.5K 12-card release remains active.
Non-release O:NR cards remain not deck_legal in the runtime catalog.
steps: Apply the runtime release gate and promote the 20 V1.0.6K cards to implemented, playable and deck_legal.
Validate V1.0.6K Runner and Corp smoke decks through the deck validator.
Play Runner draw and economy cards, install WuTech Mem Chip and Wild Card, and use Wild Card through the existing sentry-breaker rules.
Play Corp economy, draw, tagged-runner punishment and meat-damage operations.
Rez Filter, Fire Wall, Keeper and Mazer and verify unrezzed ICE remains hidden until rez.
expected: V1.0.6K adds exactly 20 further local O:NR cards.
Runtime catalog contains 32 local O:NR release cards total, including the previous 12 from V1.0.5K.
Deck validation and private match setup accept the new cards.
Visibility, replay and StateHash contracts remain covered by the existing engine and server tests.
Private local text and image artifacts remain ignored and are not versioned.
